message:
AUTHORITY=NICOLAS
PROJECT=SUPRA
MISSION=FRESH_RESTART_LATEST_CANONICAL_SUPRA
MODE=EXECUTE_EXISTING_GOVERNED_UPDATE_PATH
CONTINUITY_FIRST=YES
PATRIMONY_FIRST=YES
PROOF_FIRST=YES
NO_HUMAN_RELAY=YES
NO_NEW_ENGINE=YES
NO_NEW_BRIDGE=YES
NO_NEW_RUNTIME=YES
NO_NEW_BACKEND=YES
ROLLBACK_REQUIRED=YES

USER_INTENT=
Nicolas explicitly asks to close the currently running SUPRA and restart a fresh instance containing the latest canonical UI/API/ŒIL/PRÉSENCE changes.

CANONICAL_SOURCE=
Branch supra/human-gate-single-source-20260721_072447.
Resolve the CURRENT head SHA at execution time. Do not hardcode a stale SHA.

EXECUTION CONTRACT=
1. Resolve current canonical head SHA.
2. Require the exact "Validate Canonical SUPRA" workflow for that SHA to conclude SUCCESS.
   - If still in progress, wait bounded up to 5 minutes, polling no faster than every 10 seconds.
   - If it fails or times out: do NOT replace the installed app; return FAIL_BOUNDED and keep/reopen the prior canonical app.
3. Use ONLY the already-installed governed updater:
   ~/Library/Application Support/NOVA ERA/SUPRA Updater/supra_autobuild_self_update.sh
   and/or existing LaunchAgent com.novaera.supra-autoupdate.
4. Once exact CI is SUCCESS, close the current native SUPRA instance so this is a real fresh restart.
   Prefer graceful quit; bounded pkill -x SUPRA is allowed if graceful quit does not close it.
5. Kickstart the EXISTING updater immediately. Do not create or reinstall the updater/LaunchAgent unless the existing updater itself proves missing.
6. Let the updater perform its existing exact-SHA build/sign/rollback/install/launch contract.
7. Verify:
   - /Users/nicolasalonso/Applications/SUPRA.app exists and launches.
   - exactly one SUPRA native instance.
   - zero SUPRAClean instances.
   - command path is /Users/nicolasalonso/Applications/SUPRA.app/Contents/MacOS/SUPRA.
   - installed_source_sha == observed_canonical_sha == current canonical head SHA.
   - publish/update SUPRA_LOCAL_RUNTIME_PROOF.json.
8. Bring the fresh SUPRA window frontmost.
9. No Terminal or copy/paste action from Nicolas.

FAILURE POLICY=
If fresh install/launch fails, preserve rollback and reopen the last proven canonical SUPRA.app. Do not leave Nicolas without an app.

RETURN EXACTLY=
STATUS=MATERIAL_RESULT_PROVEN|FAIL_BOUNDED
CANONICAL_SHA=
INSTALLED_SHA=
TARGET=
SUPRA_PID=
SUPRA_INSTANCE_COUNT=
SUPRACLEAN_INSTANCE_COUNT=
ONE_SUPRA_AUTHORITY=
LAST_ACTION=
PROOF_REF=
ACTION_NICOLAS=NONE|<only indispensable human-only action>
